items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee lists Trummy Young as a musician who will be in an upcoming event ('And Trummy Young is going to be in it') and mentions a third-party conflict involving Trummy ('he and Trummy got along good'), but does not describe a personal relationship between himself and Trummy.

ctx.x: And Trummy Young is going to be in it.
Trummy, Teddy Buckner, Cozy Cole, probably either Red Callender or Arvelle Shaw, either one of them. If he can get away from that theater -- MRS BIGARD VOICE: And Dick Carey on the piano.
And Dick Carey on the piano. That's going to be the third night.
